hints.title: READ THE GROUND
hints.text: The deep earth hides water, ice and fire. Learn to read the ground before your pickaxe does. Dig east!

hints.title: GROUNDWATER
hints.text: You have just picked up a pump - keep it for now. The shimmering earth below the end of this tunnel hides groundwater: dig down through it and the basin underneath floods. The silicon is down there.

hints.title: SWIMMING IS SLOW
hints.text: In water you move only every second step, so never race a creature through a flood. Too slow for you? Press 5 in or beside the water: the pump drains it.

hints.title: BASALT
hints.text: Volcanic basalt blocks the ledge above. Real basalt is hard, but this old seam is cracked right through and crumbles away by itself. If it still stands, wait - it will not last a minute.

hints.title: SNAKES SWIM
hints.text: In the flooded chamber below swims a mine snake. Snakes are strong swimmers: water never stops them. This one is walled in - in the open mines they are not.

hints.title: GEIGER COUNTER
hints.text: A Geiger counter lies in the gallery below. Hidden bonus elements sit in ordinary-looking earth: press 3 to scan for 15 seconds, then dig the glowing spots (+150 each). Two are buried in this gallery.

hints.title: GLACIAL ICE
hints.text: That blue wall is ice, too thick for your pickaxe: only a blast breaks it. Take the sticks, stand beside the ice and press 1 - then get well clear before the fuse burns down.

hints.title: MOLTEN LAVA
hints.text: The glowing vein in the chamber below is a lava vein, and lava has already filled the pit under it. One step into lava is fatal, and digging the vein lets more out. Lava never climbs: cross above the vein.

hints.title: ELEMENTS MASTERED
hints.text: Water, ice, lava, basalt - nothing in the ground can surprise you now. Next: the machines of the old mine. Take the exit!
